turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hey Leo! How's your Sunday going down in Austin? Did you get any rock climbing in this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! No climbing today, just having a lazy Sunday. I actually just finished having a decaf americano and I'm just waking up slowly.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A decaf americano sounds like a great, relaxing way to start the morning. It's great you're sticking to the doctor's advice from your check-up. Do you have any plans for the rest of the day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I'm actually going to head out in a bit to meet a friend. I just got dressed and put on a button-down shirt.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A button-down shirt sounds like a nice Sunday look. Are you guys planning on grabbing some lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We are. I'm planning to get a deli sandwich from a spot nearby.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh nice! Are you getting a vegetarian deli sandwich? I know you always keep it vegetarian.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh definitely, they make a really good marinated tofu and avocado deli sandwich that is completely vegetarian.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! It's always nice to have good vegetarian options close by. How have things been at the logistics firm lately? Are you staying busy as an account manager?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been pretty hectic, honestly. Managing all those accounts takes a lot of energy, so I really need these quiet weekends to recharge.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine! It's good you're taking today to relax. Maybe you can get some guitar practice in later tonight too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the plan. I'll probably play some guitar after I get back and Sam finishes up his errands.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a perfect Sunday. Enjoy your lunch and your afternoon!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I will. Talk to you later!
